paths.description: Homepage/feed, global navigation and primary discovery surface.
Representative watch/detail page and core playback journey.
Primary search-results journey using the query “news”.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored on the homepage
findings.evidence: Homepage light and dark screenshots are byte-identical (41,016-byte source PNGs); computed color-scheme is normal and CSS has no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and adapt surface tokens with prefers-color-scheme/light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no View Transition treatment
findings.evidence: CSS probe found no view-transition rules and sampled route changes render as full abrupt navigations.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “same-document-transitions” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Long feeds provide no scroll-state-aware navigation cue
findings.evidence: The long homepage/feed has 24,842 px content height, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “shrinking-header-on-scroll” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: The homepage overflows by 778 px at a 360 px viewport
findings.evidence: Mobile layout reported scrollWidth 1,138 vs clientWidth 360, horizontalOverflowPx 778; screenshot shows desktop-width content.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the viewport/layout width calculation and use intrinsic, fluid sizing so scrollWidth never exceeds the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Repeated cards do not adapt at component scope
findings.evidence: CSS probe found no @container/container-type despite repeated cards reused across homepage, category, channel, and search grids.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “size-aware-styling” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Many controls and links are below minimum target size
findings.evidence: Probe enumerated many 17–21 px-high links/buttons and 13 px search-filter inputs; multiple interactive targets are below 24 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “accessibility” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Core watch and search journeys do not complete reliably
findings.evidence: Watch screenshot is a blank black player area; /search/news/videos visibly returns panda results rather than news.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore player bootstrap and correct query propagation so the requested term controls results; add end-to-end tests.

findings.summary: The blank player and failed search provide no recovery state
findings.evidence: Blank watch player and mismatched search results show no explanatory error, retry, or actionable recovery control.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “persistent-toast-notifications” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Lighthouse measured a 20.5 s LCP
findings.evidence: Lighthouse performance was 0.54 with LCP 20.5 s, FCP 8.0 s and TTI 20.6 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, remove failed critical dependencies, and defer non-critical work.

findings.summary: The sole stylesheet is blocked by ORB and supporting assets fail
findings.evidence: HAR records the parser-blocking stylesheet as net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB, a 404 image, and a failed manifest.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the stylesheet with a correct CSS MIME type/CORS posture, repair asset URLs, and make the critical style independently cacheable.

findings.summary: Blocked CSS leaves the homepage as cramped browser-default text
findings.evidence: Homepage screenshot displays browser-default serif text, bullets, and unstyled controls because the stylesheet is blocked.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “improve-text-layout-and-legibility” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow fails and targets are undersized
findings.evidence: At 360×800 the page overflows 778 px; probe also found many 13–21 px-high controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “fluid-scaling” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Lighthouse observed browser console errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse audit errors-in-console scored 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “html” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Assets are unsound: blocked CSS, a 404 image, and 92 images without dimensions
findings.evidence: HAR records blocked CSS and a 404; images probe found all 92 images lack width/height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “html” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Large first-party JavaScript lacks valid source maps
findings.evidence: Lighthouse valid-source-maps scored 0 for large first-party JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “html” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Category and search templates omit canonical signals
findings.evidence: Category and search probes returned no rel=canonical; Lighthouse also reports invalid hreflang/canonical signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “html” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: The document lacks CSP and nosniff despite HTTPS/HSTS
findings.evidence: Headers probe confirms HTTPS and HSTS, but CSP and X-Content-Type-Options are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing CSP and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff while retaining HSTS.

findings.summary: The authentication entry point does not activate in the observed homepage
findings.evidence: Attempting the visible Connect action left the broken homepage unchanged; no in-context authentication UI or modern auth option became available.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “passkeys” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Clickjacking, referrer and permissions defenses are absent
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “security” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Raw HTML exposes none of the rendered content
findings.evidence: Discoverability primitive measured 0% raw/rendered word coverage, raw text 11 characters, no raw title/H1/description, and isJsShell=true.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render meaningful title, description, headings and feed/detail content into the initial HTML.

findings.summary: A blocked critical stylesheet collapses the homepage runtime presentation
findings.evidence: ORB blocks the only parser-inserted stylesheet, leaving the homepage unstyled while the watch surface presents a blank player.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “resilient-context-menus-and-nested-dropdowns” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: The manifest fetch fails and no service worker is registered
findings.evidence: PWA probe found zero service-worker registrations and the linked manifest failed to fetch.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “html” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Network/resource failure produces blank or unstyled surfaces without recovery
findings.evidence: Observed stylesheet/manifest/player failures result in an unstyled page or blank player without retry or offline/error messaging.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “persistent-toast-notifications” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Locale attributes exist but sampled CSS uses no logical properties
findings.evidence: html lang=en-US and dir=ltr are correct, but sampled CSS contains no logical-property signal for bidi/writing-mode adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “translator” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Images omit dimensions, responsive sources, and modern formats
findings.evidence: Images probe: 92/92 missing dimensions, 48 missing srcset, 2 legacy-format, and zero modern-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height, srcset/sizes, lazy loading and modern formats for media thumbnails.

findings.summary: Ninety-one below-fold images load eagerly
findings.evidence: Images probe reports 91 below-fold images without loading=lazy.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “deprioritize-background-fetches” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: The homepage loads 69 images and 438 KB from CDN subdomains up front
findings.evidence: HAR loads 74 requests/475,527 bytes; 71 requests and 438,204 bytes are on Dailymotion CDN subdomains, including 69 eager images.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “efficient-background-processing” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

findings.summary: Search/content capabilities are not exposed in a structured agent interface
findings.evidence: DOM/source probes found no WebMCP or agent-tool registration even though search and content retrieval are core capabilities.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply Modern Web Guidance “webmcp” to address this check and verify under the same captured condition.

Fix mobile reflow and interactive target sizing
Server-render meaningful public content for non-JS crawlers
Bring LCP into the good range
Add CSP and defensive browser headers
Correct search query propagation and watch playback
Adopt modern navigation, scroll-state, logical-property and agent affordances
